positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Windchill system developer / administrator
●	Database administration and maintenance
●	Front and back-end web development using primarily SQL, Visual Basic, Java, and JavaScript
●	Construction and maintenance of web-site to display data stored within complex database system
●	Designing and programming automation software, custom reports, and custom user enhancements with various API tools, SQL, and programming knowledge
●	Programmed modules within an application to convert CAD models to 3D PDFs, generate documents based on associated object data, and automate process workflow
●	Rigid and thorough testing of new software capabilities on development systems prior to pushing updates to live environments
●	Writing and implementing plans for developing new and enhanced features
●	Communicating with customers throughout the development and implementation of new enhancements or features, to ensure they meet implementation plan criteria and user expectations
●	High-availability support for userbase for both Eastern and Pacific time zones
●	Data security enforcement
positions.insights: Skills: Svelte · ASP.NET · JavaScript · SQL · C# · TypeScript · Oracle Database · Windchill

positions.title: Process Engineer
positions.description:
Process Line Owner responsible for operations and performance
Feed Readiness Lead for analyzing current and future feed materials for safe processing
Established and implemented testing plan for new processes and feeds
Managed testing performance, including schedule and personnel
Led troubleshooting and repair activities
Charged with performance of special projects on existing process lines
Coordinated with multiple work groups to maintain safety, schedule and budget

positions.title: Lab Assistant
positions.description: Solution Preparation and mixing, general chemistry laboratory preparation and assistance.

projects.title: MatLab: Distillation Column Design
projects.description: I wrote the MatLab simulation code, calculated all costing, modeled it in Aspen, and interpreted the results of the code into charts within the design report. I wrote the sections detailing these as well as providing all sample calculations in the report.

projects.title: Oxygen Transport in Body
projects.description: A simplified model of the delivery method of oxygen within the body was mathematically evaluated based on simplified blood vessels and organs to explain the method with which oxygen is transported from the lungs throughout the body.

organizations.name: AIChE
organizations.description: Attended school events to recruit new members, social events to integrate them into the club, as well as national and regional meetings to learn skills to improve our student chapter.

organizations.name: Chemical Engineering Car
organizations.description: Recruiting new members, encouraging participation and teamwork, guiding the assembled team toward the production of a mechanically sound chemically driven (and stopped) car that adhered to the safety, technical, and financial specifications given. Responsibilities also included written reports on all topics, posters on our reactions, applications for funding, and social events to encourage further participation.
